description: This file contains implementation of a thread-safe buffer queue with chunk management, including functions for initialization, reading, writing, peeking, skipping, and passing data. It is part of the libcurl project and handles buffered data for network operations.

methods.name: bool chunk_is_empty(const struct buf_chunk * chunk)
methods.description: Checks if the buffer chunk is empty based on read and write offsets.

methods.name: bool chunk_is_full(const struct buf_chunk * chunk)
methods.description: Checks if the buffer chunk is full based on write offset and data length.

methods.name: size_t chunk_len(const struct buf_chunk * chunk)
methods.description: Returns the current data length in the chunk.

methods.name: size_t chunk_space(const struct buf_chunk * chunk)
methods.description: Returns the available space in the chunk.

methods.name: void chunk_reset(struct buf_chunk * chunk)
methods.description: Resets the chunk offsets and next pointer.

methods.name: size_t chunk_append(struct buf_chunk * chunk,const unsigned char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Appends data to the chunk, returning number of bytes written.

methods.name: size_t chunk_read(struct buf_chunk * chunk,unsigned char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Reads data from the chunk into a buffer.

methods.name: ssize_t chunk_slurpn(struct buf_chunk * chunk,size_t max_len,Curl_bufq_reader * reader,void * reader_ctx,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Reads data from an external reader into the chunk buffer.

methods.name: void chunk_peek(const struct buf_chunk * chunk,const unsigned char ** pbuf,size_t * plen)
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the current data in the chunk.

methods.name: void chunk_peek_at(const struct buf_chunk * chunk,size_t offset,const unsigned char ** pbuf,size_t * plen)
methods.description: Provides a pointer to data at a specific offset within the chunk.

methods.name: size_t chunk_skip(struct buf_chunk * chunk,size_t amount)
methods.description: Advances the read offset within the chunk, effectively skipping data.

methods.name: void chunk_list_free(struct buf_chunk ** anchor)
methods.description: Frees all chunks in a linked list.

methods.name: void Curl_bufcp_init(struct bufc_pool * pool,size_t chunk_size,size_t spare_max)
methods.description: Initializes a buffer chunk pool with specified chunk size and max spare chunks.

methods.name: CURLcode bufcp_take(struct bufc_pool * pool,struct buf_chunk ** pchunk)
methods.description: Takes a chunk from the pool or allocates a new one.

methods.name: void bufcp_put(struct bufc_pool * pool,struct buf_chunk * chunk)
methods.description: Returns a chunk to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: void Curl_bufcp_free(struct bufc_pool * pool)
methods.description: Frees all spare chunks in the pool.

methods.name: void bufq_init(struct bufq * q,struct bufc_pool * pool,size_t chunk_size,size_t max_chunks,int opts)
methods.description: Initializes a buffer queue with specific parameters.

methods.name: void Curl_bufq_init2(struct bufq * q,size_t chunk_size,size_t max_chunks,int opts)
methods.description: Initializes a buffer queue with chunk size, max chunks, and default options.

methods.name: void Curl_bufq_init(struct bufq * q,size_t chunk_size,size_t max_chunks)
methods.description: Initializes a buffer queue with chunk size and max chunks, default options.

methods.name: void Curl_bufq_initp(struct bufq * q,struct bufc_pool * pool,size_t max_chunks,int opts)
methods.description: Initializes a buffer queue using a buffer chunk pool.

methods.name: void Curl_bufq_free(struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Frees the buffer queue and associated resources.

methods.name: void Curl_bufq_reset(struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Resets the buffer queue, freeing all chunks and spares.

methods.name: size_t Curl_bufq_len(const struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Returns total length of data in the queue.

methods.name: size_t Curl_bufq_space(const struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Returns available space in the queue.

methods.name: bool Curl_bufq_is_empty(const struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Checks if the buffer queue is empty.

methods.name: bool Curl_bufq_is_full(const struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Checks if the buffer queue is full.

methods.name: struct:buf_chunk * get_spare(struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Retrieves a spare chunk from the pool or allocates a new one.

methods.name: void prune_head(struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Removes and frees empty chunks from the head of the queue.

methods.name: struct:buf_chunk * get_non_full_tail(struct bufq * q)
methods.description: Gets the tail chunk that is not full, adding a new one if necessary.

methods.name: ssize_t Curl_bufq_write(struct bufq * q,const unsigned char * buf,size_t len,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer queue, returning the number of bytes written.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_bufq_cwrite(struct bufq * q,const char * buf,size_t len,size_t * pnwritten)
methods.description: Writable wrapper around Curl_bufq_write, returning CURLcode.

methods.name: ssize_t Curl_bufq_read(struct bufq * q,unsigned char * buf,size_t len,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer queue into a buffer.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_bufq_cread(struct bufq * q,char * buf,size_t len,size_t * pnread)
methods.description: Readable wrapper around Curl_bufq_read, returning CURLcode.

methods.name: bool Curl_bufq_peek(struct bufq * q,const unsigned char ** pbuf,size_t * plen)
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the first available data chunk.

methods.name: bool Curl_bufq_peek_at(struct bufq * q,size_t offset,const unsigned char ** pbuf,size_t * plen)
methods.description: Provides a pointer to data at an offset within the queue.

methods.name: void Curl_bufq_skip(struct bufq * q,size_t amount)
methods.description: Skips data in the buffer queue.

methods.name: ssize_t Curl_bufq_pass(struct bufq * q,Curl_bufq_writer * writer,void * writer_ctx,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Passes data from the buffer queue to a writer callback.

methods.name: ssize_t Curl_bufq_write_pass(struct bufq * q,const unsigned char * buf,size_t len,Curl_bufq_writer * writer,void * writer_ctx,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Attempts to write data to the buffer queue and passes excess data to a writer.

methods.name: ssize_t Curl_bufq_sipn(struct bufq * q,size_t max_len,Curl_bufq_reader * reader,void * reader_ctx,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Slurps data from a reader into the buffer queue up to max length.

methods.name: ssize_t bufq_slurpn(struct bufq * q,size_t max_len,Curl_bufq_reader * reader,void * reader_ctx,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Internal function to repeatedly slurp data until max length or EOF.

methods.name: ssize_t Curl_bufq_slurp(struct bufq * q,Curl_bufq_reader * reader,void * reader_ctx,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Slurps all available data from a reader into the queue.
